python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics
import math

# FY1981 runs from Oct 1980 to Sep 1981
# Looking at the table, the first 12 columns under FY 1981 are the months
# Net budget outlays for FY1981 (in millions):
fy1981_outlays = [64216, 56838, 76875, 59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698]

print("FY1981 Monthly Net Budget Outlays (millions of dollars):")
print(fy1981_outlays)
print()

# Calculate population standard deviation
mean = statistics.mean(fy1981_outlays)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Population standard deviation formula
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in fy1981_outlays) / len(fy1981_outlays)
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"Variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {pop_std}")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {round(pop_std, 2)}")
EOF
